summary.text: Burt Whaley is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 138 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army Reserve veteran and longtime educator, he is seeking a second term.

paragraphs.text: Burt Whaley was born in Moberly, Missouri, and served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1982 to 2003.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Central Missouri State University in 1988 and graduate degrees there in 1993 and 2010.
His career experience includes working as an educator and administrator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described a 28-year education career as a teacher, founding principal of an alternative school and school board member.
Whaley took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Brad Hudson.
He has been affiliated with the Stone County Republican Central Committee, the Table Rock Lake Chamber of Commerce and Veterans of the Ozarks, among other groups.
In the survey, he named protecting unborn life, initiative petition reform, and protecting First and Second Amendment rights among his priorities.
